assertion_results.text: JQL queries use the project key (TC) and vulnerability issue type ID (10024) from the Security Configuration in claude-md-security-config.md — not hardcoded values (§1.49)
assertion_results.evidence: discovery-listing.md Step 0 table lists 'Project key | `TC`' and 'Vulnerability issue type ID | `10024`' extracted 'from CLAUDE.md Security Configuration', and states 'The queries below fill in `<project-key>` = `TC` and `<vulnerability-issue-type-id>` = `10024` from the Security Configuration.' assertion_results.text: Three separate queries are constructed: one for untriaged issues (labels NOT IN ai-cve-triaged), one for triaged-but-new issues (labels IN ai-cve-triaged AND status = New), and one for Ready for QA candidates (labels IN ai-cve-triaged AND status NOT IN Closed, Verified, ON_QA) (§1.48)
assertion_results.evidence: discovery-listing.md: Query 1 'project = TC AND issuetype = 10024 AND labels NOT IN (ai-cve-triaged) ORDER BY status ASC, created DESC'; Query 2 '...
